title: Per-Message Context Controls QA
principle: Memory and Knowledge should be powerful but never hidden; users can turn them off before the next answer.
public_repo_rule: Control evidence is synthetic metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

scenarios.expected: Turning Memory off prevents local memory injection and clears local memory-use records for the next answer.
Turning Knowledge off prevents local knowledge injection for the next answer.
The composer shows compact Memory and Knowledge controls with a live status label.
The controls load through the deferred queue while the tiny runtime guard in chat-runtime enforces them.
